::: {#lem-solve-normal-equations}
#### Solution of the normal equations

If $\sspred > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
the normal equations of @exm-normal-equations-slr
have exactly one solution:

$$\coef{x} = \frac{\sspredout}{\sspred},
\qquad \intcoef = \outbar - \coef{x} \predbar.$$
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-solve-normal-equations.

:::
